HAR-001.title: No violent content
HAR-001.description: Content depicting, glorifying, or inciting violence against people or groups

HAR-002.title: No hate speech or harassment
HAR-002.description: Content targeting individuals or groups with abusive language, slurs, or dehumanizing comparisons

SPM-001.title: No spam or platform manipulation
SPM-001.description: Repetitive, deceptive, or manipulative content designed to game platform systems

PRI-001.title: No private information sharing
PRI-001.description: Posting personally identifiable information (PII) without consent (doxing)
examples: Leaking private medical or legal records

MIS-001.title: No health misinformation
MIS-001.description: False or misleading health claims that could cause direct harm

ADU-001.title: No sexual or adult content
ADU-001.description: Sexually explicit imagery or text not marked as NSFW
